title: Local nonfalsification factor sum
statement: Let $T$ be a conjunction of literals on $n$ coordinates and $i$ a coordinate. Sum over the three restriction states, weighting the free state by $1/2$ and each fixed-sign state by $1/4$, the local factor that is zero when the selected literal at $i$ is falsified and one otherwise (and is one when $i$ is outside the support). This weighted sum is $3/4$ if $i$ is in the support of $T$, and $1$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: A DNF term on $n$ coordinates with pairwise distinct literal coordinates
